rows.en: Muramatsu or Arashi is defeated
All allies are destroyed
Variblune sure looks mighty reliable every time I see it! Oh, here it comes! Whoa, that's one big missile!

It's the Drill Missile, developed by EAGLE's scientists with everything they've got.

Fired from Variblune, the Drill Missile burrows 50 meters underground and then explodes!
So it's a homing torpedo for the land, then…
With that, Variblune's unstoppable, isn't it, Shinmei?
…Hm? Oh, yeah, I can't wait to sortie! Right, Variblune?
Hoi! General Temujin, sir! Construction of the underground missile base is complete.
Excellent. This time I'll finish off Gorenger for good…
General Temujin, sir!
What is it?
Hoi! His Excellency the Fuhrer has gone out to a strategy meeting!!

What!? A strategy meeting? Nonsense!

Going over my head, when I am the general… Who on earth would he hold a strategy meeting with? Grr, I must know who it is!
…Right. Follow His Excellency's car without being noticed!
Stop!
Grr!? What? What's going on?
Could it be? Isn't that an underground base!?
Hmm… So His Excellency isn't satisfied with my strategies, and has another corps… All right, come here!
Hoi!

Ask those Naager people for reinforcements!

Begin the all-out attack at once! I will crush Gorenger… I will do it myself!
Commander! Unidentified fighters are attacking the city.
All riiight, let's go clean them up. Variblune, launch! Go!
Is that them? Let's go, Dai!
Rooojer!
Good, lure them out while we fight!
They've taken the bait! This is Iron Mask… Underground base, fire the missiles!
Roger! Firing missiles!
Shinmei, it's missiles!? They're bein' fired from underground!
I see, the air raid on Tokyo… was a diversion to lure Variblune out!?
Heh heh heh… Too late to notice now! Eat this!!
Dai, you said the Drill Missile burrows 50 meters underground, right?
That I did.
…All riiight, let's give it a shot!
Rooojer! Switch on!
Hoi hoi! Hoiii!?
Uoooh!?
That's some power, Shinmei. Hooray for the Drill Missile!
Heh… Farewell, Lord Iron Mask!
C'mon, Shinmei, let's hurry up and whup the enemy! I'm already starvin'!
Mmm, that's tasty! Curry after a victory tastes extra special! Master, seconds!
Huh? What was that?
Seconds.
…Honestly. You'd be a good customer, too, if you didn't keep running up a tab…

Hey, Dai… Heard you really shone out there? Variblune's unbeatable.

Still… it's rare for you to come to Amigo. Is Gon closed today?
Oh, Mr. Oiwa. You're here? Variblune really shone out there, didn't it?
But… it's rare, isn't it? You coming to Amigo… Is Snack Gon closed today?
Today's the day I stock up on ingredients. Besides… Amigo's curry ain't half bad!

I never dreamed they would develop an underground missile.

But… next time I will crush them without fail! Please watch me!
Wait! Pushing yourself any harder will only end the same way. You will fight in a joint front with another corps.
A joint front?
Who are you!?
Called here from Mount Hekla in Iceland… Volcano Mask General Magman!!

General Magman?

With respect, Your Excellency… I need no one else's help to dispose of Gorenger!
Wasn't your underground base blown up? You can no longer win on your own.
Curse you! You dare insult me!?
Calm yourself! This is unseemly, Iron Mask!
Kuh… I will defeat Gorenger myself!
Your Excellency… He is no longer fit to be a commander.
Meanwhile, at the crater of Mount Kitayama, a volcano research group from Toto University was carrying out a survey.
Kitayama, a dormant volcano, had suddenly become active of late. But there, a terrible trap set by Volcano Mask General Magman lay in wait…
Commander! Mount Kitayama has erupted, and the Toto University research group is in trouble!
Ao, Ki! Take Variblune and rescue them.
Understood. …Dai!
You got it! Variblune!
Aka, Momo, Mido! You handle it from the ground.
Yes, sir! Let's go!
Okay!
Shinmei, it's Kitayama!
All right, we're landing.
Heh heh heh heh heh… They've flown right into my trap!
Okay, let's go! Go!
Ah, hold on! Go!
So the Black Cross Army's come out to greet us!
No problem, no problem! They're no match for the great Kirenger!
There they are! The Toto University research group.
All riiight!
Hey, pull yourself together!
I'll save ya right now!
Ugh, a chain on my arm!?

uncertain: Daita Oiwa's Kyushu dialect rendered as light folksy English (ya, bein', ain't); 新命どん rendered as plain "Shinmei".
U06640/U06643: Edogawa's codenames アオ/キ/アカ/モモ/ミド kept romanized (Ao, Ki, Aka, Momo, Mido) as Gorenger nicknames; could be "Blue, Yellow, Red, Pink, Green" instead.
U06581: イーグル written EAGLE (the Gorenger organization); not in glossary under this spelling.
U06595: 他の軍団を… unfinished; read as Temujin suspecting the Fuhrer has brought in another corps.
U06614: ドリルミサイル百歳 read as 万歳 ("Hooray for"); see glyph_suspects.
U06636: 彼 referred to as "He" (Temujin, established male general).

new_names.why: not in glossary as a whole
short form of Iron Mask General Temujin
Tachibana's snack bar; not in glossary
